prompt: Create and publish a NEW phone-first App Life XP (Chinese title \u4eba\u751f\u7ecf\u9a8c\u503c), slug life-xp-demo, at /workspace/life-xp-demo. Chinese UI. Default habits: \u559d\u6c34 +10 XP, \u8fd0\u52a8 +30 XP, \u8bfb\u4e66 +20 XP. Start XP and history empty, never fake historical records. Level = 1 + floor(total XP / 50). SQLite query returns {rows,count}; render rows; _limit/_order_by exact names. Use schema_path, skill frontmatter name life-xp-demo. All assets local.
